method: Reproducible representative-token lexical-semantic candidate screen, supplemented by inspection of repeated community exemplars and measured intercommunity/transition evidence. Categories are provisional, not proved latent concepts.

control.kind: globally shuffled vocabulary labels; graph shape preserved
control.interpretation: Sensitivity check only; lexicon was defined post-hoc, so not an independent semantic ground truth.

key_findings: Early/input states include distinct communities of waterways, settlements, built structures, landscape, movement and routes.
Some route and settlement associations continue through early/middle transformer states.
S06/S07 networks are highly recurrent across generated-token decisions, but provisional candidate parents are predominantly off-topic.
No strong inference that these late-state representations preserve question-relevant utility or that they caused the generated continuation.
The generated continuation is poor; whether the early/intermediate associations are useful beyond that output is reserved for human evaluation.
limitations: Generated answer and possible adjacent domains were previously disclosed; analysis cannot be claimed blind.
Only compact representative/extreme token lists, class counts, community edges and transition metrics were available remotely, not 1.42 million raw token memberships.
Most communities remained unresolved by the conservative candidate lexicon.
No inference that negative cosine denotes semantic suppression.
No claim of causal links from hidden states to generated tokens.
One model and one prompt; no generality claim.
frozen_run_status_note: Measurement manifest retained as awaiting_semantic_analysis; separate analysis manifest records the semantic-screening output, while human usefulness evaluation and the strongest scientific inference remain open.
